title: Taiwanese American Student Association at Georgia Tech
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Student Association at Georgia Tech (GT TASA) is a registered student organization at the Georgia Institute of Technology in Atlanta, Georgia. It is listed in both the Georgia Tech OMED Student Resource Hub and the Georgia Tech SGA’s JacketPages organization directory, confirming its standing as a recognized campus organization. The group maintains a Facebook page at facebook.com/gttasa and an Instagram account at @gt_tasa.

GT TASA describes itself as a cultural organization whose goal is to spread Taiwanese culture, as stated on its Facebook page. The organization has hosted a variety of community-facing events, including a Taiwanese Night Market — a student-run event modeled on Taiwan’s street market culture — that has drawn participation from multiple campus clubs. GT TASA is oriented toward Taiwanese American students and others interested in Taiwanese culture, and has historically engaged with the broader Atlanta-area Taiwanese American community through its programming.
